task_definition.task_description: Please check the living room light’s current status and scene snapshot, then set it to a 70% brightness scene and turn it on. After that, find the living room smart lock and lock it with PIN 2468, then check AAPL, estimate the trading cost for a 5-share stock sale at a VIP rate, and place the sell order. Finally, get Alice’s contact info, create and email her a high-priority document titled “IoT and Trade Execution Summary” with the note “Light adjusted, area lock updated, sell order placed, and business news attached for follow-up,” and then fetch the latest business news.

user_input.query: Please check the current status and scene snapshot for my living room light, specifically light_living, then set it to a 70% brightness scene and turn it on. After that, find the smart lock in the living_room area, set its state to lock, and lock it using PIN 2468. Then check AAPL, estimate the trading cost for selling 5 shares at the vip rate, and place the sell order. Next, get the contact info for alice, create a document titled “IoT and Trade Execution Summary” with the content “Light adjusted, area lock updated, sell order placed, and business news attached for follow-up.”, and send it through email with high priority. Finally, fetch the latest business news.
user_input.document_content: Light adjusted, area lock updated, sell order placed, and business news attached for follow-up.
